questions.question: Where did our story first begin?
questions.explanation: That very first message sparked a flame that has grown brighter every single day. I still reread our early messages with a huge smile! 💕

questions.question: What is my absolute favorite thing about you?
options: The way your eyes light up ✨
questions.explanation: Trick question! How could I ever choose just one thing? You are my favorite person in every possible way. ❤️

questions.question: What was the very first movie or show we watched together?
options: A horror movie where we held hands tight 👻
questions.explanation: We spent more time laughing and sharing glances than actually watching the screen! A memory I'll treasure forever. 🍿

questions.question: Which snack or food do we always end up craving together?
questions.explanation: No matter the hour, sweet creamy ice cream tastes 10x better when shared with you! 🍦

questions.question: What is my favorite nickname to call you when we're alone?
questions.explanation: You truly are my favorite human in the entire universe! 🥰

questions.question: What was our first memorable date like?
questions.explanation: Walking beside you that evening, time felt like it stopped. I knew right then you were someone special. 🌹

questions.question: What song instantly makes me think of you?
questions.explanation: Whenever our song plays, my heart skips a beat just like the first day we met! 🎧

questions.question: What is my favorite memory with you so far?
options: Our endless deep conversations at 2 AM 🌙
Every single second spent with you! ❤️
questions.explanation: Every moment spent with you becomes a prized memory in my heart. 💖

questions.question: Who gave in first and confessed their feelings?
options: Me! I couldn't hold it in 💖
We both said it at the exact same time! ✨
It was obvious without even speaking 🤫
questions.explanation: I couldn't hide how head-over-heels I was for you any longer! Best confession ever. 💘

questions.question: What is our favorite unspoken ritual when we say goodbye?
options: A tight warm hug that lasts 10 seconds 🫂
Looking back and waving three times 👋
Sending a 'get home safe' text immediately 📱
questions.explanation: A gentle kiss on your forehead carries all my love and protection for you. 💕

questions.question: What is something funny or cute that always makes us laugh?
options: Inside jokes no one else understands 🤫
questions.explanation: Our secret inside jokes are the absolute best. We can share a look and burst out laughing! 😂

questions.question: If we were trapped on a deserted island, what's the one thing I'd bring?
questions.explanation: With you by my side, even a deserted island would feel like paradise! 🏝️

questions.question: What weather is our absolute favorite for cuddling?
options: Chilly winter night under warm blankets ❄️
questions.explanation: Rain drops on the window, cozy blankets, and warm hugs with you—perfection! 🌧️

questions.question: What is my dream travel destination with you?
options: Cozy cabin under the Northern Lights 🌌
Anywhere, as long as we're together! 🗺️
questions.explanation: The destination doesn't matter nearly as much as the hand I get to hold while traveling there! ✈️

questions.question: What super power would best describe our connection?
options: Mind reading (we finish each other's sentences) 🧠
questions.explanation: No matter how tough a day is, one warm embrace from you instantly makes everything alright. 🫂

questions.question: What do I love doing with you on a lazy Sunday?
questions.explanation: Lazy Sundays with you are the purest form of happiness! ☕

questions.question: What is the sweetest gift or gesture you ever gave me?
options: A warm embrace when I needed it most 🫂
Just being your amazing self every day 🌟
questions.explanation: Your presence in my life is the greatest gift I could ever ask for. ❤️

questions.question: What do we love doing together late at night?
options: Talking about our big dreams for the future 🌟
Listening to soft music side by side 🎶
questions.explanation: Building our future in conversation under the night sky is my absolute favorite pastime. ✨

questions.question: How many times a day do I think about you?
options: Just once... because you never leave my mind! ❤️
questions.explanation: You entered my heart and decided to stay forever. You're always on my mind! 🥰

questions.question: What is my ultimate promise to you?
options: To hold your hand through every storm ⛈️
To love you more today than yesterday 💕
To cherish and love you forever & always ❤️
questions.explanation: Forever & always, in every lifetime, my heart belongs to you. ❤️✨

loveLetter.title: To My Dearest Love,
paragraphs: Thank you for embarking on this little romantic journey with me today. Every question in this quiz is a tiny reflection of the massive love I hold in my heart for you.
From the moment you entered my life, everything became brighter, warmer, and infinitely more beautiful. You have shown me what true love, laughter, and companionship really mean.
No matter where life takes us, through every storm and every celebration, I promise to stand by your side, hold your hand tight, and love you more with every passing sunrise.
You are my favorite hello, my hardest goodbye, my best friend, and my soulmate. I love you infinitely! ❤️
